messages.author: e9efb5e0c1023b61
messages.subject: Drop tip from beast object
parts:
How to drop tips from a class "beast" object in ggtree? 

It is easy to drop tips from a class "phylo" object with ape::drop.tip. 

But I don't see a straightforward way to do it with "beast" class in ggtree, since the "beast" class is needed for functions like geom_range.

messages.author: 29046c717c72679b
messages.subject: Re: Drop tip from beast object
parts:
I have the same problem. I want to drop tips, but keep all the annotation info in the beast object.

I could drop tips with a beast tree with the package phyloch, with drop.tips2.

It just doesn't work with ggtree.
Is there any other solution?
